description: Verify that the build log contains no lines matching the regex 'error' (case-insensitive).
Verify that the build log contains no lines matching the regex 'fatal' (case-insensitive).
Verify that the build log contains a line matching the regex 'Build succeeded' or 'Build finished' (case-insensitive).
Verify that the build log does not contain any lines starting with 'make: ***' or 'gmake: ***' (indicating make errors).
